messages:
lee wang: Heads up: Prospect Marshline wants a migration viability POC. Key asks: token parity, stop-sequence fidelity, pricing delta for 1.2M chats/mo. They also want answers for their security questionnaire about data residency and header handling.

emma (se): Ran a 1k prompt pass. Findings: tokenization differences concentrated on concatenated punctuation and CJK characters. Average delta ~5.5%, tail 18%. Stop sequences that contain punctuation sometimes get fragmented.

natalie (pm): Can we offer a suggested compatibility shim and a clear POC scope? Include a minimal adapter that normalizes text, and a pre/post-processing step to enforce stop tokens. Also block asking legal about retention.

rachel (security): For hosted POC we can disable X-Forwarded-For and redact headers. Data residency: hosted will process in their preferred region if available; otherwise Dedicated or Private is recommended.

deploy-bot: Canary 0.13.0 -> staging by @emma (se) at 2025-12-11T19:03Z

emma (se): I'll package a token-delta report and a short harness script they can run. Also will include sample output diffs and a suggested normalization pipeline.

lee wang: Thanks team. Please drop artifacts in the shared drive and I'll send them over.
